description:
The agent-proxy dry-run on 2026-04-28 found that
`docs/contributing-results.md` Prerequisites #1 linked to
`getting-started.rst` at the wrong relative path (the file lives at
`docs/usage/getting-started.md`, not `docs/getting-started.rst`). The
link itself is patched in the same PR as the retrospective. The repo
now has Sphinx linkcheck coverage in `.github/workflows/docs.yml` and
`make docs-linkcheck`; this TODO exists to explain why that existing
coverage did not prevent the source-relative link regression, then
patch the smallest gap in the existing docs validation surface.

See `_project/handoffs/external-dry-run-retrospective-2026-04-28.md`
for the originating finding.

anti_patterns.dont: add a second generic link checker before explaining why the existing Sphinx linkcheck missed the regression
anti_patterns.why: duplicated docs gates create noise without proving this failure mode is covered

anti_patterns.dont: whitelist the originally-broken path to make linkcheck pass
anti_patterns.why: that defeats the purpose of adding the check

preserves.behavior: Docs CI total wall-clock stays within the existing budget (linkcheck added as a parallel job, not serialized after the slow build)
Existing relative links in `docs/` that currently resolve continue to resolve (no false positives from a poorly-tuned linkcheck config)
External-link 404s remain advisory, not blocking -- a third-party link rotting should not block a docs PR

prior_art.concept: .github/workflows/docs.yml — existing blocking Sphinx linkcheck job; EXTEND before adding a separate checker
Makefile — existing `ci-linkcheck`, `docs-linkcheck`, and `docs-check` wrappers; REUSE for local verification
docs/conf.py — existing `linkcheck_ignore` configuration; EXTEND only for flaky external URLs, not local relative-link misses

verifications.description: Existing Sphinx linkcheck remains wired into docs CI
verifications.expected: docs.yml and Makefile both contain linkcheck wiring

verifications.description: The originally-broken source-relative path no longer appears
Docs linkcheck passes after the coverage-gap fix

work_units.notes:
Current prior art:
  - `.github/workflows/docs.yml` has a blocking `linkcheck` job.
  - `Makefile` has `ci-linkcheck`, `docs-linkcheck`, and
    `docs-check` wrappers.
  - `docs/index.rst` includes `contributing-results.md` in the
    toctree.
Reconstruct the failure mode from the 2026-04-28 dry-run context:
was the link fixed before linkcheck ran, was linkcheck absent from
the relevant PR gate at the time, did MyST/Sphinx not validate the
source-relative target shape, or did the path only break in the
GitHub-rendered markdown view?
work_units.summary: Reproduce why existing Sphinx linkcheck missed the original source-relative link

work_units.notes:
Prefer extending the existing Sphinx/docs validation path over
adding a second link checker. Examples:
  - If `docs/contributing-results.md` was not in the checked source
    set at the time, add an explicit regression assertion to
    `docs-validate` or the docs CI job.
  - If Sphinx validates built links but not GitHub-rendered markdown
    source links, add a small markdown relative-link check scoped to
    repo-local targets.
  - Add `markdown-link-check` only if the Sphinx path cannot cover
    this exact failure mode.
work_units.summary: Patch the existing docs validation surface at the narrowest failing layer

work_units.notes:
Run the existing docs linkcheck and the new/extended local-link
assertion. Fix local relative-link failures in the same PR if they
are under `docs/`; file separate follow-ups for unrelated generated
docs or broad external-link cleanup.
work_units.summary: Run the docs link checks and fix any other latent local-link breakage
